item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the calibrated livebait coefficient is not distinguishable from zero or is unstable after adjustment for hours, persons, child, and camper.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Estimate fish_caught per hour using a calibrated exposure-offset model, comparing livebait groups while adjusting for camper, persons, and child; include a no-effect negative-control comparison.","mechanism":"Live bait increases effective catch rate by attracting more fish during a fishing trip.","mechanism_key":"livebait_increases_rate","predictions":[{"direction":"higher","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait-group rate is not higher, or the estimate fails calibration checks.","observable":"Adjusted fish caught per hour for livebait users versus non-users","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the calibrated livebait effect is clearly positive or negative across reasonable model specifications.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Fit a calibrated model with livebait as a prespecified covariate and test its conditional effect after accounting for hours, camper, persons, and child; verify the negative control remains null.","mechanism":"Live bait does not materially change catch rate; apparent differences arise from exposure, group composition, or random variation.","mechanism_key":"livebait_no_effect","predictions":[{"direction":"no_difference","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"A reproducible nonzero adjusted livebait effect remains after calibration and controls.","observable":"Adjusted fish caught per hour for livebait users versus non-users","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if livebait users have a positive or null adjusted catch-rate difference, or if the negative-control/calibration checks fail.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Use the same calibrated exposure-offset model and prespecified adjustment set, checking for selection and measurement artifacts before interpreting the livebait contrast.","mechanism":"Live bait is associated with lower effective catch rate, potentially because it is chosen in poorer fishing conditions or by less successful groups.","mechanism_key":"livebait_decreases_rate","predictions":[{"direction":"lower","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The adjusted livebait-group rate is not lower under calibrated measurement and controls.","observable":"Adjusted fish caught per hour for livebait users versus non-users","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"How many fish on average do visitors catch per hour, and how do livebait, camper status, group composition, and fishing hours influence the estimated catch rate?"}
